title: Good Bye, Lenin! (KINO)
synopsis: When Alex's mother, a devoted socialist activist, falls into a coma in October 1989, she misses the fall of the Berlin Wall entirely. Eight months later, she awakens, her heart too fragile for the truth. To keep her alive, Alex goes to extraordinary lengths to preserve the illusion of a world that no longer exists. A landmark of world cinema and one of the most cherished German films ever made, Good Bye, Lenin! endures as a timeless testament to love, memory, and identity. Tonight's screening is a heartfelt homage to its visionary director, the late Wolfgang Becker.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 1989年東德變天，柏林圍牆倒下，獨裁政權倒台。只是阿歷的愛國愛黨母親因陷入昏迷而錯過了巨變時刻。八個月後當她醒來，阿歷為免令母親再受刺激心臟病發，唯有和親友們夾計，扭盡六壬搞出一場又一場大龍鳳重構東柏林的大小事物，為的就是讓相信社會主義就是最好的母親放心，以為東德政權仍然健在。電影在2003年上映時驚艷全球，更成為其中一部最廣為各地觀眾認識的德國電影，導演禾夫靳碧嘉以喜中帶悲的手法，帶出大時代下的親情與身分認同，讓這部電影成為相關主題的經典。

cast: Daniel Brühl, Katrin Sass, Chulpan Khamatova
